quotasettings_trim_description: Trimming keeps a document as it is now and deletes everything before it: its editing history, its named versions, its chat history, and figures it no longer uses. Comments stay.
quotasettings_trim_keeps_after: ” as it is now and permanently deletes everything before it:
quotasettings_trim_figures_item: Figures its current files no longer use, except ones uploaded in the last hour
quotasettings_trim_footer: Comments stay. This cannot be undone.
quotasettings_delete_template_rest: ” will move to the trash, where it stays for seven days. Until then you can put it back.
quotasettings_template_failed: The template could not be deleted.
quotasettings_load_failed: Storage status could not be loaded.
editorsettings_font_description: Six fonts are included and download when you pick one. Another font has to be installed on this computer.
editorsettings_font_size_description: Pinch or Ctrl and scroll over the editor to change it there too.
editorsettings_completion_description: Suggest commands, labels and citations while you type.
editorsettings_brackets_description: Typing an opening bracket adds the closing one.
editorsettings_proofing_description_brow: Your browser underlines misspelled words in prose, skipping commands, code, math and citation keys. Its language and dictionary decide what counts as a word.
editorsettings_proofing_description_harp: Harper checks English spelling and grammar in prose. It downloads 7 MB the first time and uses about 300 MB of memory while a document is open. Documents that declare another language get the browser's spellcheck instead.
editorsettings_check_description: Underline errors and warnings from the last render in the editor. The list of messages stays available.
editorsettings_visual_description: Open sources with headings, figures and maths drawn in place. The switch in the top bar changes it for one session.
editorsettings_shortcuts_description: Press ? anywhere outside the editor to come back here.
